original_candidates.reason: The immediately preceding immutable physical install already supplies the matching manifest. No core file changes occur between the two statements; subsequent real CLI setup and all original assertions remain.

policies.explicit-basis-or-live: Generic preparation uses the live source by default. A caller-supplied immutable basis selects its captured content explicitly; source and basis cannot be combined.
policies.explicit-immutable-current: This caller explicitly selects the fixed current candidate basis; each result is an independent physical copy, with product inspection and later mutations unchanged.
policies.new-content-capture: A new explicit basis is generated from actual source contents. The declared current owner calls once under its initialization lock; mutable/different sources request separate captures.
policies.real-copy-mutation: The historical Viewer implementation is installed into this private copy; its caller retains actual manifest regeneration.
policies.real-historical-material: The exact local historical package is extracted for its explicit compatibility/recovery scenario; no current basis substitutes for it.
policies.real-regeneration: Hashes the actual selected copy, including post-pin, edited, added, removed or deliberately changed material. No manifest cache replaces this call.

removed_initial_regenerations.reason: The immediately preceding immutable physical install already supplies the matching manifest. No core file changes occur between the two statements; subsequent real CLI setup and all original assertions remain.
